skill.summary: Allocate Elastic IP Address (EIP) and bind to existing Alibaba Cloud resources. Supports ECS instances, ENI, CLB, NAT Gateway, HAVIP, and IP addresses. Focus...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Require Aliyun CLI version 3.3.3 or higher; updated installation and version check instructions.
- Added mandatory step to update Aliyun CLI plugins before use (`aliyun plugin update`).
- Updated all AlibabaCloud CLI commands to include the full skill user-agent string: `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-network-eip-associate`.
- Improved and clarified pre-check and setup steps in documentation.
- Minor fixes and clarifications in step descriptions and workflow text.
